description: WebhookManager can register and unregister webhooks
steps: Call register_webhook with url and events
Call get_webhook to verify it exists

description: Webhooks only receive events they are subscribed to
Webhook deliveries include proper headers and JSON payload
steps: Verify delivery contains X-Webhook-ID, X-Delivery-ID, X-Event-Type headers
Verify payload contains event type, data, timestamp

description: HMAC-SHA256 signature is generated when secret is provided
Disabled webhooks do not receive deliveries
